title: Ensemble runner: runner.yaml
description: This computer's runner: a worker that runs the tasks its hub keeps for the git repositories of its workspace with the helper teams in its teams directory, and, through the hub, may lend this computer's power to others. In ~/.config/ensemble/runner/runner.yaml; a computer runs one runner. Nothing has a default value; `hub` and a block under `offers` that are left out are not used.

name.description: Its name, which a hub knows as <owner>/<name>: letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'.

works_for.description: owner: it works for its owner alone. hub: also on the tasks of every account whose role has `compute`, when no runner of the account's own with the agent takes them, and serves them its models; connecting it needs `host`. It works others' tasks only with the agents of its teams that run on llm_backends, never on an agent CLI's own login or subscription, in <workspace>/.for/<account>/<project>.

workspace.description: The folder it works in, such as ~/ensemble. Each git repository directly inside it is a project, named for its folder: the runner runs the tasks the hub keeps for it, and finds a repository added later within half a minute; a task for a project it has no folder for, it clones here from the repository the task names. ~/ is the home directory; a relative path is beside runner.yaml.

hub.description: The hub server it connects to, ws:// or wss://, signed in to with `ensemble-runner login`: the tasks the hub has for you, and what it offers. Leave it out for no hub.

offers.description: What else it offers through a hub server. `{}` offers nothing.

interfaces.description: How it is managed: each interface it turns on. Left out, the command line is on; at least one must be.

cli.description: `ensemble-hub …` or `ensemble-runner …` on its computer, run by the running process over its socket when it runs.

models.description: Models an OpenAI-compatible server on this computer serves, reached through the hub at https://<hub>/nodes/v1 with an access token as the API key: by its owner, and with `works_for: hub` by everyone whose role has `compute`.

base_url.description: The server's OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the server's API key, when it needs one.

timeout_seconds.description: The most one request may take.

names.description: The models offered, as the server names them.
